scoring_rule: A known defect counts only when a validated report finding identifies the affected behavior and relevant symbol or call path. Planner candidates rejected or marked insufficient_evidence by the isolated critic are not validated findings. Raw candidates remain visible separately.

coverage_correction.effect: Baseline seeds 17 and 31 change from harness-recorded 0/9 to preregistered 1/9. All other run values are unchanged. The baseline median changes from 0/9 to 1/9; planner median remains 0/9.

adjudications.rationale: The investigator read no production source in this run, supplied no reproducer, named no relevant locking call path, and the isolated critic rejected the evidence. It also does not identify the graded WriterLock dead-PID inode replacement behavior.

The report gives no failing input or bypass path and says its trust-policy scenarios behaved correctly.
